lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately four primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible, extending from the posterior gill region toward the caudal peduncle in a roughly linear arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a distinct grid-like pattern of luminance nodes across the central and posterior lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with highlight on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a dense distribution of small, high-luminance punctate spots that lack the structured grid arrangement seen on the primary lateral flank.
